Costo intralogistics 
Vacancy Service Engineer . - MBO 2/3 - Full-time 
Customers contact you when they experience faults with the intralogistics systems we have supplied, such as conveyors, lifts and high-bay cranes. 
 What does the role involve? 
As a Service Engineer at Costo, you ensure that our customers' intralogistics systems keep running reliably. You combine mechanical and electrical expertise to resolve faults and carry out maintenance. You work closely with your colleagues and act as the customer's main point of contact on site. 
 Ready to apply? 
 What does your day as a Service Engineer at Costo look like? 
Customers contact you when they experience faults with the intralogistics systems we have supplied, such as conveyors, lifts and high-bay cranes. You assess the amount of work involved and determine the priority. You or one of your service colleagues then visits the customer to resolve the technical issue. On site, you are the main point of contact for the customer. In addition to troubleshooting, you carry out preventive maintenance and service projects on location. You mainly work with your technically focused service colleagues, but also with the Service Manager and service colleagues specialising in software. 
Your responsibilities will include: - Carrying out all types of service work on site. - Providing input to the Service Manager for quotations for service work. - Participating in the on-call service rota (1 week in every 4). 
 Who are we looking for? 
A technically skilled professional with strong mechanical and electrical knowledge who also communicates confidently. You have at least three years of experience in a service-oriented role, for example as a technician with coordinating responsibilities. You are able to maintain a clear overview and set the right priorities. You have an excellent command of Dutch. Good English language skills are an advantage. 
Do you also have at least an MBO level 2/3 technica...

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a side job that you can combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for a part-time order picker for both the morning and evening shifts. These shifts alternate weekly. In this role, you ensure that all orders are prepared correctly, completely, and on time for shipment.

As an order picker, you start by collecting orders in the warehouse. Using a scanner and headset, you gather the correct products while carefully checking quantities and items.

Are all products complete? Then you ensure careful and safe packaging. You select the right packaging materials, label the order correctly, and perform a final check before it is shipped.

You will work in a two-shift system: a morning shift from 07:00 to 16:00 and an evening shift from 16:00 to 00:00, alternating weekly. This means you work the early shift one week and the late shift the next.

Additionally, you are willing to work one Saturday per month from 08:00 to 16:00.

- Available at least 2 working days per week
- Able to work in a two-shift system
- Flexible, including one Saturday every four weeks
- Physically capable of active work
- A team player who speaks Dutch or English
- Experience as an order picker is a plus, but not required
